text:
olivia: Heads-up — release promo got auto-stopped by deploy-bot. Canary failed and artifact push timed out to staging.
deploy-bot: promo aborted for release/v1.8.2 — reason: multiple job failures (canary-e2e, artifact-upload). See https://ci.internal/runs/7012345 :warning:
olivia: logs show PUT to s3://redwood-staging/images timed out, 30s retry exhausted. snippet: `PUT https://s3-eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/... 504`
max: ugh. Is it consistently 504 or intermittent?
rachel: canary-e2e also had a flake: payments-e2e timed out waiting for test fixture (db-setup). It's failing ~2/3 runs.
sre-oncall: I'm seeing a cache-metadata 409 on the artifact index service right before the PUT timeout — might be service-side throttling on the staging bucket.
olivia: deploy-bot shows both errors in same window ~7012345672-7012345678. Possibly a burst of uploads + e2e retries.
max: options: 1) manual promote previous image, 2) re-run canary with a pinned runner, 3) isolate payments-e2e and quarantine it. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
rachel: quarantine the test if it's flaky and unblock, but we should be cautious — payments covers critical flow. If we pin previous image we avoid exposing customers to any new infra change.
sre-oncall: I'll open a staging S3 throttle ticket and bump the upload concurrency limit to 4 for 15m. That might stop the 504s. Meanwhile we can trigger a focused rerun.
olivia: can someone do a manual /retrigger for canary with limited concurrency? Command: `/retest --pipeline release-canary --concurrency 1`
max: kicked off rerun: https://ci.internal/runs/7012346 — limiting to single upload worker.
deploy-bot: rerun started by max. jobs: canary-e2e, artifact-upload. ETA ~8m.
max: rerun failed — payments-e2e 1/1 still timed out at 2m:45s. log: `ERROR: fixture init took > 90s, aborting`
rachel: that test needs a DB seed fix. I'll cut a quick fix branch to reduce fixture setup time, but that will take ~30–45m to get green.
max: with deploy window closing in 40m, we need decision: hold and wait for hotfix, or manual promote previous image to prod and ship release notes later.
sre-oncall: If we manual-promote, we should also adjust rollout to 10% and monitor metrics. I can set a slower canary ramp.
olivia: consensus? :slightly_smiling_face:
rachel: I'm in favor of pinning previous image and opening a follow-up change to repro/repair payments-e2e. We avoid risking a broken payments flow in prod.
max: +1. I'll start manual promote to last-known-good image tag `v1.8.1-20260320`. Will update release channel and release notes.
deploy-bot: manual-promote job queued by max. Note: this bypasses auto-canary checks — ensure SRE monitoring is enabled.
sre-oncall: I'll attach increased alerting for payments latency and error-rate, and set canary ramp to 10% per 30m.
olivia: thanks all. Action items: max -> run manual promote and update release notes; rachel -> open hotspot PR for payments fixture; sre-oncall -> monitoring tweaks + S3 concurrency bump follow-up ticket. We'll reconvene if anything else fails. :thumbsup:
